issues.issue: Whether discrimination from family, society and workplace amounts to persecution
issues.applicant_position: RPD misunderstood the claim by focusing on family opinion and workplace discrimination.
issues.result_text: Court agrees discriminatory behaviour did not cumulatively amount to persecution.

issues.issue: Whether a viable internal flight alternative exists in Mumbai, Hyderabad, Bangalore, Kolkata or Delhi cities
issues.applicant_position: VHP has a wide network and can find them anywhere; no IFA exists in the named cities.
issues.result_text: No internal flight alternative exists in India for the appellants; RPD's IFA analysis was wrong.

issues.issue: Whether the supplementary documentation is admissible as new evidence
issues.applicant_position: Submitted supplementary documents and articles on VHP actions, Love Jihad and police connectivity.
issues.result_text: Supplementary documentation accepted as new evidence under IRPA s.110(4) and considered.

issues.issue: Whether adequate state protection is available in India
issues.applicant_position: VHP works with BJP; police refused complaints; state protection presumption is rebutted.
issues.result_text: Appellants rebutted the presumption of state protection in major cities and elsewhere in India.
